_comment: Example tenant: a restaurant. SAME engine as luna-base, completely different output - proof the plugin is brand-neutral. No CMS (publishes via GitHub), magazine-light layout, no academic numbering, no APA, photos instead of data figures, stat rigor off.

_forbidden_colors._comment: Keep brand off generic Tailwind blues/purples.

format._comment: Restaurant look: magazine-light. Photo hero, magazine body, no numbering, simple sources, decorative imagery, wordmark footer. The opposite of editorial-dark.

images._comment: Where the THUMBNAIL and SOCIAL images come from. provider 'canva' = Claude writes a fresh clickbait prompt per piece and generates the image with the connected Canva tools at session time, then exports PNG. provider 'svg' = legacy inline SVG. NOTE: in-article blog figures are ALWAYS SVG regardless. Sizes verified June 2026.
images._provider_options: canva (requires the Canva connector) | svg (no external dependency)
images._style_note: Header may carry one short, bold clickbait HEADLINE (<=8 words, real wording). The ONLY brand wordmark allowed is exactly company.domain, small in a bottom-corner FOOTER - no tagline, no other text, no numbers unless real. Method: let Canva generate the visual + headline + wordmark, then AUDIT the editable text - fix the headline if mangled, make the wordmark read exactly company.domain, and DELETE any junk/gibberish/duplicate text - then commit. Never trust the generator spelling.

sizes._blog_thumbnail_note: Open Graph / link-preview standard (1.91:1). Keep headline + faces in center 1080x600 safe zone.
sizes._linkedin_note: Square feed image for strong presence. Landscape/link alt: 1200x627.
sizes._facebook_note: Portrait 4:5 for max mobile real estate. Square alt: 1080x1080; landscape/link alt: 1200x630.

voice._comment: One account is enough for a small restaurant.

svg_figure._comment: Unused (figures disabled) but kept for schema completeness.

content_model._comment: Restaurant content model - nothing B2B here.

A.label: Story
A.intent: Chef story, ingredient origin, seasonal feature

campaign_defaults._comment: Defaults for the campaign-planning skill (objectives, KPI templates per objective, budget currency, phases).

seo._comment: SEO + Google quality settings used by the seo-optimization skill and the blog skill to make posts INDEXABLE, E-E-A-T compliant, and intent-matched. See skills/seo-optimization/references/google-seo-standards.md.
seo._quality_gate_options: strict (do not mark a post publish-ready until every E-E-A-T / indexability / human-voice / intent check passes) | advisory (flag issues, allow) | off

eeat._comment: Real identity signals for Experience/Expertise/Authoritativeness/Trust and the JSON-LD author/publisher. Fill with a REAL person/org; empty weakens E-E-A-T.

video._comment: On-demand short-form video. provider 'higgsfield' uses the connected Higgsfield MCP (mcp.higgsfield.ai); tool-agnostic - any ~~video MCP works. Higgsfield clips max ~15s. Per-platform specs so each post gets the right aspect. Generating video consumes Higgsfield credits (free plan = 0).
video._default_model_note: Optional: pin a Higgsfield video model id (e.g. veo, kling, sora). Empty = the skill calls models_explore/recommend to pick per shot.
video._style_note: First-1-second hook, fast cuts, on-screen text kept short and CORRECT (added as overlay, never trust AI to spell long text), end CTA + company.domain wordmark, on-brand palette colors. No fabricated claims.

automation._comment: Calendar-driven video. When the content calendar marks a day as a video post, the video-production skill (calendar mode) auto-WRITES the script + GENERATES the clip, but does NOT post. mode 'review' = save to outputs/video/pending and notify; the user approves + posts. Needs a Claude session (MCP), so trigger via a Cowork scheduled task, not the headless cron.
automation._mode_options: review (create clip, wait for approval, then user posts) | auto-post (create + post automatically)
